reason: The cited evidence supports that DNN potentials with active learning can be trained on AIMD data for solid and liquid HEA states (E3) and that active learning tailors potentials to specific systems (E2), but no evidence quantifies a 40–50% error reduction or directly benchmarks DNN free-energy integration against TOR-TILD EAM for CoCrFeMnNi.
